issues.description: The problem statement (Aufgabe 07) requests a list of the NAMES of Gemeinden that have a "Freibad" and the NAMES of the respective Freibäder. The provided solution file returns Gemeinde.schluessel and Schwimmbad.id (keys) instead of the requested names, which is a structural mismatch between the exercise requirement and the reference solution and will confuse students when comparing their results with the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Update solution_repository/aufgabe07.sql to select the Gemeinde and Schwimmbad names rather than keys. For example: SELECT Gemeinde.name, Schwimmbad.name FROM Gemeinde, Schwimmbad WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel AND Schwimmbad.art = 'Freibad'. This aligns the reference solution with the problem statement.

issues.description: Task 07 in the problem statement requests the names of the Gemeinden and the names of the respective Freibäder, but the solution query returns Gemeinde.schluessel and Schwimmbad.id (keys/IDs) instead of the requested name attributes. This mismatch between the conceptual entity 'name' in the problem and the identifiers used in the solution will prevent students from mapping the requirement ('Namen ...') to the provided implementation and causes unnecessary confusion.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution to select the name columns requested by the problem: e.g. SELECT Gemeinde.name, Schwimmbad.name FROM Gemeinde, Schwimmbad WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel AND Schwimmbad.art = 'Freibad'. Ensure the template and solution both use Gemeinde.name and Schwimmbad.name for clarity.
